prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D game character animation key-pose atlas.
Primary request: create ONE SQUARE production sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns and 4 rows, sixteen separated full-body poses of the SAME referenced character. Every pose is centered in its invisible equal square cell; keep all weapon tips and body contours inside that cell with minimum 15 percent safety margins. Identical character body scale across poses; no overlapping cells. Grid is conceptual only, DO NOT draw grid, labels or numbers.
Camera: consistent orthographic game camera elevated 45 degrees above the ground, looking down, visibly see tops of head and shoulders, foreshortened body. Not an eye-level front portrait. Rows 1 and 2 face diagonally toward screen BOTTOM RIGHT, show three-quarter FRONT. Rows 3 and 4 face diagonally toward screen TOP RIGHT, show true three-quarter BACK, backs of heads, back clothing and heels, do not turn head toward viewer; no face/front chest on back poses.
Pose order left-to-right, row-by-row:
ROW 1 FRONT: idle grounded ready; walk contact with clearly split legs; walk passing with ONE knee lifted and OTHER leg planted directly under hip (distinct leg silhouette from previous); attack windup.
ROW 2 FRONT: attack release/impact; recoiling from hit; knees buckling downward; kneeling collapsed defeated.
ROW 3 BACK: idle grounded ready; walk contact split legs; walk passing one knee up and other leg planted under hip; attack windup.
ROW 4 BACK: attack release/impact; recoiling from hit; knees buckling downward; kneeling collapsed defeated.
Style: retain exact illustrated cel-shaded hand-drawn eastern fantasy style, readable volumes, crisp dark outlines and flat shaded planes of the reference. Preserve identity, materials, palette, all main costume and equipment. Make volume from form shading, not floor shadows.
Output: actual transparent alpha background; isolated body and carried weapon only; no ground shadows, circles, floors, scenery, text, checkerboard, captions, glow, motion streaks, floating particles or detached effects. Exactly sixteen characters.
Image 1 is character identity/style reference only. Subject: gray rat slinger, small anthropomorphic GRAY RAT with large round pink-inner ears, ivory cloth headband tied at rear, short shabby IVORY cross-collar robe, ochre belt, charcoal baggy trousers, brown wrist wraps, bare pink clawed toes, long pink curved tail rooted normally behind the body. Weapons: one simple leather SLING and a small brown STONE POUCH at the waist, no blade or bow. Identity and costume match the reference.
Critical production spacing: render EACH full-body pose as a SMALL sprite in its cell, about 50-60% of cell width and height, with generous fully transparent empty space on all four sides. Total canvas 4x4 square cells with center positions 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% on both axes. Tail and sling stay entirely inside its own cell. No clipping. The output should look spacious, NOT crammed with touching characters.
All first eight poses INCLUDING THE VERY FIRST IDLE face diagonally down-right with real face visible. All last eight face diagonally up-right, showing back of head/headband knot, rear robe and tail base, no face or snout looking back at camera. Make front walking contact and passing visibly distinct legs. On windup, sling arm raised with cord folded upward within the cell; on release, arm extended toward facing direction, open empty sling retained in hand. No detached projectile stone or motion lines; stone projectiles will be added by game engine. Do not draw the soft dark halo from the reference. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND.
notes: Sixteen key poses, not a full frame-by-frame animation. Visual inspection only; exact 45-degree projection and 15-percent margins are requested constraints, not measured guarantees.
